ui.note: v1.0.9: COMPLETE FIX - Explicit Window Width/Height in XAML. Increased FontSize (15-24pt). UTF8-BOM-Patch.ps1 v1.3 with explicit encoding. All windows properly sized and styled.

changelog.v1.0.9: COMPLETE FIX: (1) Added explicit Width/Height attributes to ALL XAML Window tags. (2) Increased FontSize throughout (Button=15, TextBlock=14-24). (3) UTF8-BOM-Patch.ps1 v1.3 - CRITICAL FIX: Explicit UTF-8 encoding (NO autodetection). Uses StreamReader with correct BOM handling and explicit UTF8Encoding($true) for writing. (4) Improved spacing and margins in all XAML files.
changelog.v1.0.8: Window sizing infrastructure - Added Set-WindowSize() function with rigorous [double] casting. Improved config hashtable conversion for nested objects.
changelog.v1.0.7: Dynamic window sizing from config.json. Checkbox logic fix prevents unselecting both. Close button checks for unsaved changes. Save dialog returns to main (no exit). Fonts increased (+1-2pt). Button spacing increased (16-24px).
changelog.v1.0.6: UTF-8 with BOM encoding for ALL files (XAML, PowerShell, JSON, Markdown). Fixes character display issues with German umlauts (ä,ö,ü,ß).
changelog.v1.0.5: CRITICAL FIX: Fixed Setter.View error (should be Value). Optimized window sizes to avoid 'too large' issue.
changelog.v1.0.4: Major UI Overhaul: UTF-8 BOM encoding, larger fonts, gray buttons, correct checkmark symbols, bigger icons, improved spacing.
changelog.v1.0.3: UI Enhancement: Window sizes increased, uniform button colors, improved spacing.
changelog.v1.0.2: Critical Fix: Remove DropShadow Effect from XAML.
changelog.v1.0.1: Bug Fix: Correct invalid hex color values.
